 Panchayat Season 5 OTT release date update: When and where to watch Jitendra Kumar, Neena Gupta's hit series online
 SECTIONS Panchayat Season 5 OTT release date update: When and where to watch Jitendra Kumar, Neena Gupta's hit series online By ET Entertainment Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 15, 2026, 01:32:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Fans of Panchayat are eagerly waiting for the release date of Season 5. The anticipated show will address unresolved issues from the previous season, including village elections and relationships. Abhishek's challenges in Phulera are set to continue under new leadership while pursuing his MBA ambitions. Read on!
 Streaming details of Panchayat Season 5 (Credit: Instagram) Fans have been eagerly waiting for the release of the much-awaited show Panchayat Season 5 . The hit show will pick up right after the dramatic village election upset at the end. Produced by The Viral Fever (TVF) and created by Chandan Kumar, the makers have finally update us about the release date of Season 5.
 Update on Panchayat Season 5 release date
Taking to their social media handle, Prime Video shared a post stated, "Panchayat Season 5. Is saal nahi aayega. batate hue khed hai, Panchayat ka agla season qaid hai"
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by prime video IN (@primevideoin) 
According to the recent announcement from Amazon Prime Video. While earlier reports suggested a late 2026 premiere, the streaming platform shared a cryptic promotional poster featuring Bhushan (Banrakas) stating that the new season is delayed.
The post went viral in no time and received mixed reactions from audience.
 More about Panchayat Season 5
Abhishek Tripathi, the engineering graduate turned panchayat secretary whose journey in Phulera has remained the heart of the story in season 5, will again be seen as Jitendra Kumar . The new season is also likely to see the return of familiar faces like Neena Gupta , Raghubir Yadav, Sanvikaa, Faisal Malik and Chandan Roy.
The series is created by The Viral Fever. It is written by Chandan Kumar and directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra, the team behind the show’s relatable storytelling and grounded humour.
All you need to know about Panchayat Season 5
Several unresolved issues from Season 4 will be addressed in the upcoming season, according to the creators. In a 2025 interview with IANS, author Chandan Kumar hinted that viewers might anticipate answers regarding the village elections, the relationship between Sachiv ji and Rinki, and the mystery surrounding the attack on Pradhan Ji.
Neena Gupta added to the excitement with her witty reaction to fan theories about the election outcome. While discussing predictions that Manju Devi could return stronger, the actress said, "The script has leaked. Get ready for the next season - the script has already leaked!”
What to expect from the new season
The official synopsis hints at a challenging time ahead for Abhishek Tripathi in Phulera, especially under its new and vengeful leadership. While he tries to focus on his MBA plans and build a future beyond the village, unresolved issues and old conflicts keep drawing him back into Phulera's politics and personal troubles.
The storyline is expected to continue directly from where it left off in Season 4. Abhishek passed his CAT exam and finally opened up to Rinki about his feelings. Meanwhile, in a major twist in the village election, Manju Devi lost to Kranti Devi, changing the power equation in Phulera.
Now, stay tuned for more details about the upcoming season.
